resources.string: Changes are saved on this device first. Tap Sync Now to exchange changes with your file. Internet and Google authorization are required only for connection and sync.
File sync completed. Newer local edits remain pending.
Keep working on this device. Your file connection and local records are saved. When internet returns, tap Sync Now to send pending changes.

Paninda cannot reach the selected file. It may have been deleted, access may have changed, or Google may be temporarily unavailable. Your local records and pending changes are safe. Check the file and retry sync.
Google authorization needs attention. Your selected file and local records are still saved. Tap Sync Now to authorize again and retry.
Sync could not finish. Your selected file, local records and pending changes are kept. Keep working locally and retry when ready.
Sync did not complete. Local work is preserved; check Sync Status and retry.
Google access could not be revoked. Your selected file and local session are still kept. Connect to the internet and retry disconnecting.
